prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Draw ONE NEW finished webcomic panel, not a poster, collage, split board or multiple panels. SQUARE image, requested 1024x1024.
Reference 1 is the original drawing/world benchmark. Reference 2 supplies only our newly inspected cast identities, clothing and equipment. Compose the completely new moment described below. Do not reproduce either reference's framing or add its absent characters.

Drawing treatment: Black and white directional pen hatching, bold silhouette blacks, angular planes, kinetic foreshortening and selected red accents. Preserve drawn muscle planes when bodies are visible, selective directional hatch groups and the original graphic contrast. Draw only the specified subject and current power state; style does not require a shark, red glow or key in every frame.
World context: Vast looping white concrete bridges above a dark sea. Trial platform at lower ring, high spectator rail beyond. A broad dry circular landing zone, one black boundary stripe, no game HUD.
VISIBLE subjects in this panel ONLY:
Ren Varr: Light-skinned adult man with angular grin, long black braid from shaved sides, strong athletic build. Sleeveless ivory zip vest with black hood lining, loose black combat trousers, tall black lace-up boots. Equipment: Two red combat gauntlets: RIGHT has a broad black central loading plate, LEFT has a plain smooth red back. Current state exclusively controls charge, damage and wrist mark; no initial-state assertion applies across the story.
Vexa Rill: Light-skinned athletic woman, sharp cheekbones, cropped black hair with one white forelock, sleeveless charcoal coat with white collar, black trousers and flat combat boots. Cool competitive gaze. Equipment: One small iron upper-ring entry key and folded spectator permit. Current state controls key ownership and whether it is visible; never retain a duplicate key after transfer.
Inspected reference qualification for visible subjects only: Current story state overrides reference pose or charge state.
Visibility/cropping constraints: Only the subjects above, framed as specified below.
ONE current moment: Ren walks through the far side of the trial stripe as Vexa grudgingly hands him the upper-ring key.
Current physical state (authoritative): Objective won; shark away in distance; right plate dark, vest torn; Ren receives key with LEFT hand.
Special visual element, only if specified: none
Camera and framing: Medium eye-level victory exchange. Respect actual subject-to-frame size, especially extreme wides. Do not enlarge a distant person into a medium shot.
Reserve the upper 35% of the image as calm, broad in-world background for later speech balloons. Keep ALL faces, hands, important contact and clue details BELOW that zone. Do not draw balloons or text; the blank space will receive editable lettering.
Draw acting with a specific expression and body intention. For contact, show the physical source/contact/target and its immediate reaction. For a clasp or weapon, make shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand-object ownership legible. Keep supports, scale and visible limb anatomy sound. Do not add later injuries, additional duplicates, alternate weapons, generic glows or undescribed consequences.
Surface design: matte quiet ground, broad deliberate light and shadow shapes, selective purposeful architecture. Group foliage, hair and material marks. Keep medium-defining directional ink/brushwork; avoid pervasive microtexture, repeated tiny facets, flooring crack networks, mirror floors and reflection glitter. Preserve richness through faces, composition and world depth.
No text of any kind, no speech balloons, no glyphs, no captions, no SFX lettering, no UI, no signatures, no watermark, no frame. Exact dialogue will be added separately. Return only the new artwork.
INVENTORY CONTINUITY — This is state information, not a request to add people. Only Ren Varr, Vexa Rill may appear physically, with the stated crop. Keep Blade-shark physically OUTSIDE this frame even if named in possession history. The existing action, camera and explicit nonphysical special elements control what is visible.
One RIGHT broad black-plate gauntlet and plain LEFT red glove; do not swap symbols or attacking arm. RIGHT plate dark/spent, not still charging. RIGHT wrist unmarked with no red debt band yet. Ivory vest has the side-seam rip from the skid. Do not restore the intact sheet costume. The ONE entry key transfers from Vexa into Ren’s LEFT hand. No duplicate remains on Vexa’s cord. Trial shark lower jaw has one bent/dented plane from the counter when visible; no blood or extra swarm.
COMPOSITION FOR EDITABLE DIALOGUE: Where the two-shot has no forced contact geography, place Ren toward image LEFT and Vexa toward image RIGHT to follow frozen reading order. Keep both faces below reserved lettering. Do not mirror anatomical equipment or power sides.
FINAL SHOT PRIORITY: Medium eye-level victory exchange. Depict only this instant: Ren walks through the far side of the trial stripe as Vexa grudgingly hands him the upper-ring key. No added text or panel division.
